title: Translation Of Dispatch From The Public Safety Bureau

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.
（印：& S. D. REC. S. B. D. 1710. date 7 - 11 - 30.）
Translation of Despatch from the Public Safety Bureau
No. 1869. November 4, 1930.

Commissioner Barred,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

Sir,

I have to state that one S Tshung Foh (史春发)
has made a report to this Bureau saying: "My brother-
in-law, who being insane was sent to the Sing Poo Yoh
Asylum for medical attendance on October 24, had sneaked
away from the patients' ward at 5 p.m. on the same day
and has been lost since. In order to give comfort to
my aged mother-in-law who is worrying so much of the
loss of her only son, I beg that you will be kind
enough to give instructions for the tracing of the lost
person whose description is as follows: 'Tsu Ziang Foh
(朱祥福), aged 58, native of Ningpo, round face,
dark complexion, having many scars around the neck,
wearing imitation woollen cloth lined jacket and pants,
and blue striped cloth shirt and pants, black socks
and cloth shoes' ".

It is found that the above report is true.
Therefore apart from circulating the matter and giving
（批：Crs. B. Ray / Circular / C. 56" + / would / Summary / H 11/30 / * Done. A.M 7/11/30 / o Issued 14/11/30 g.d. / 6 / 11 / 1930）
the necessary instructions, I have to request that you
will be good enough to give instructions to your
subordinates for the tracing of the above described
lost person. I may also mention that any information,
please notify S Tshung Foh at No. 157 Tuh Wo Li Alleyway
in the Tuh Sing Li Alleyway at Boone Road Market directly
who will identify and take back the lost person. Please
favour us with a reply.

Yuan Liang
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau.
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
总监办公室。
（印：& S. D. REC. S. B. D. 1710. 日期 30-11-7。）

公共安全局来文译文
第1869号。1930年11月4日。

致巴尔德总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

先生：

兹陈述，史春发（S Tshung Foh）向本局报案称：“我的妹夫因患精神病，于10月24日被送往辛普尔医院（Sing Poo Yoh Asylum）接受治疗，当日下午5时从病房潜逃，至今下落不明。为安抚因独子失踪而忧心忡忡的岳母，恳请阁下指令查找该失踪人员，其体貌特征如下：‘朱祥福（Tsu Ziang Foh），58岁，宁波籍，圆脸，肤色黝黑，颈部有多处疤痕，身穿仿毛衬里夹克和长裤，蓝条纹布衬衫和长裤，黑袜及布鞋’。”

经查，上述报案属实。
因此，除将此案通缉并下达
（批：Crs. B. Ray / 通缉令 / C. 56" + / 拟办 / 摘要 / H 11/30 / * 已办。A.M 30/11/7 / o 发出 30/11/14 g.d. / 6 / 11 / 1930）
必要指令外，特请阁下惠予指令下属，查找上述体貌特征的失踪人员。另需说明，如有任何线索，请直接通知住在博恩路市场德兴里弄堂157号的史春发（S Tshung Foh），由其辨认并领回失踪人员。盼复。

公共安全局局长
袁良
